index_analysis.label: person
index_analysis.queries: equality on name (`has(key, value)`); no ranges or text search

index_analysis.label: knows
index_analysis.queries: equality on since (`has(key, value)`); no ranges or text search

findings.title: partitionBy() / clusterBy() on vertex label
findings.detail: Detected 'partitionBy' in schema DSL.
findings.remediation: partitionBy() and clusterBy() keys become regular JanusGraph property keys. Composite indexes on these keys preserve query patterns.

findings.title: mapOf(K, V) property type
findings.detail: Detected 'mapOf(' in schema DSL.
findings.remediation: Use --map-strategy flat (default) to explode map entries into parallel <prop>_key LIST and <prop>_value LIST properties. Or use --map-strategy json to serialise the entire map as a JSON string.

findings.title: setOf(X) / listOf(X) collection property
findings.detail: Detected 'setOf(' in schema DSL.
findings.remediation: setOf(X) maps to Cardinality.SET; listOf(X) maps to Cardinality.LIST. This is handled automatically by the translator.

findings.title: Geospatial property type (Point) in schema
findings.detail: Detected 'Point' in schema DSL.
findings.remediation: Point properties are automatically migrated to WKT strings with a Mapping.PREFIX_TREE mixed index. Polygon and Linestring are stored as WKT but require manual geo index configuration.

findings.title: materializedView() → composite index
findings.detail: Detected 'materializedView(' in schema DSL.
findings.remediation: materializedView is automatically translated to a composite index by the translator.

findings.title: searchIndex().by('x').asText() → mixed index with Mapping.TEXT
findings.detail: Detected 'asText(' in schema DSL.
findings.remediation: searchIndex with asText() is automatically translated to a mixed index with Mapping.TEXT. Ensure an Elasticsearch/OpenSearch backend is configured.

findings.title: searchIndex().by('x').asString() → mixed index with Mapping.STRING
findings.detail: Detected 'asString(' in schema DSL.
findings.remediation: searchIndex with asString() is automatically translated to a mixed index with Mapping.STRING.

findings.title: searchIndex() on geo property → mixed index with Mapping.PREFIX_TREE
findings.detail: Detected searchIndex on a geo property (Point type) in schema DSL.
findings.remediation: Geo searchIndex is automatically translated to a mixed index with Mapping.PREFIX_TREE. Point properties stored as WKT strings.

findings.title: Vertex-centric RelationIndex → buildEdgeIndex()
findings.detail: Detected vertex-centric edge index pattern in schema DSL.
findings.remediation: Vertex-centric indexes are automatically translated to JanusGraph vertex-centric edge indexes by the translator.

findings.title: Search.prefix() / Search.token() usage
findings.detail: searchIndex with asText/asString detected — application code likely uses Search.token() or Search.prefix(). Review and update to Text.*.
findings.remediation: Replace Search.prefix() on an asString() key with Text.textPrefix() (Mapping.STRING). Replace Search.token() with Text.textContains() and Search.tokenPrefix() with Text.textContainsPrefix() (Mapping.TEXT). The assessment's Index Analysis lists the predicates each indexed key serves.

findings.title: Geo.inside(Geo.point(...), radius) usage
findings.detail: Geo/Point type detected in schema — application code may use Geo.inside(). Review and update to Geo.within(Geoshape.circle(...)).
findings.remediation: Replace Geo.inside(Geo.point(lat, lon), radius) with Geo.within(Geoshape.circle(lat, lon, radius)). Ensure a mixed index with Mapping.PREFIX_TREE exists on the geo property.

findings.title: repeat() step global semantics change (TinkerPop 3.4 → 3.7)
findings.detail: Advisory: TinkerPop 3.4 → 3.7 breaking change applies to all DSE Graph migrations.
findings.remediation: Add explicit .until() or .times() guards to all repeat() traversals. Without guards, repeat() in TinkerPop 3.7 may loop indefinitely on large graphs.

findings.title: valueMap() return format change
findings.detail: Advisory: TinkerPop 3.4 → 3.7 breaking change applies to all DSE Graph migrations.
findings.remediation: Update valueMap() calls to include .by(unfold()) for properties with SINGLE cardinality, or update consuming code to handle List<Object> values.

findings.title: scriptEvaluationTimeout renamed to evaluationTimeout
findings.detail: Advisory: TinkerPop 3.4 → 3.7 breaking change applies to all DSE Graph migrations.
findings.remediation: Rename scriptEvaluationTimeout to evaluationTimeout in gremlin-server.yaml. Value is in milliseconds.

findings.title: GraphBinary serialisation supported
findings.detail: Advisory: TinkerPop 3.4 → 3.7 breaking change applies to all DSE Graph migrations.
findings.remediation: Update gremlin-python client to use GraphBinarySerializersV1 for improved performance. No breaking changes — fully backward compatible.

findings.title: property(k, v) cardinality resolution
findings.detail: Advisory: TinkerPop 3.4 → 3.7 breaking change applies to all DSE Graph migrations.
findings.remediation: Set schema.default=none (strict) or schema.default=default (auto-create) in janusgraph.properties. With schema.default=none, all property keys must be pre-defined before use.

findings.title: HCD AdvancedAuthenticator is enabled
findings.detail: HCD at localhost:9042 accepted the credentials and rejected an anonymous connection — password authentication is enforced. Ensure JanusGraph sets storage.username and storage.password.
findings.remediation: Set storage.username and storage.password in janusgraph.properties, supplied at deploy time (e.g. from $HCD_CQL_PASSWORD) — never committed.

findings.title: HCD materialized_views_enabled: false
findings.detail: HCD materialized_views_enabled=false confirmed — JanusGraph will not create CQL MVs. No conflict.
findings.remediation: No JanusGraph action required. Remove any pre-existing CQL MV creation scripts from your deployment automation.

findings.title: HCD guardrail defaults enforce batch-size limits
findings.detail: HCD target pre-flight advisory.
findings.remediation: Ensure storage.cql.atomic-batch-mutate=false (or omit — false is the default). Do not set storage.cql.atomic-batch-mutate=true against HCD.

findings.title: HCD storage_compatibility_mode: NONE (Cassandra 5+ SSTable formats)
findings.detail: HCD target pre-flight advisory.
findings.remediation: No action needed. Informational only.

findings.title: HCD default_secondary_index: sai
findings.detail: HCD target pre-flight advisory.
findings.remediation: No action needed. Informational only.

findings.title: HCD CQL port 9042, datacenter dc1
findings.detail: HCD target pre-flight advisory.
findings.remediation: No action needed. Fully compatible.

findings.title: HCD linux/amd64 image — Apple Silicon emulation
findings.detail: Apple Silicon (arm64) detected — HCD linux/amd64 image runs under Rosetta emulation. Expect ~2× longer startup time.
findings.remediation: Enable Rosetta emulation in Docker Desktop → Settings → Features in Development. Allocate ≥ 8 GB RAM. Expect ~2× longer startup time vs native amd64.
